evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: Mandating a signed manifest before deployment appeals to security/stability (conservation) and to craft-quality gatekeeping (competence).

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Citing past unsigned artifacts as justification for the gate frames the gate as a security safeguard — conservation of stability.
The gate header asserts a required security control (conservation) and a craft-quality checkpoint (competence).
Extending the gate's scope to both staging and production broadens the security/stability blanket — conservation.
Naming an individual owner stakes personal accountability and standing over the gate (self-enhancement) while signaling mastery of the process (competence).
